title: Synthesis and Slow Magnetic Relaxation of a Disc-like Dysprosium Cluster

material_class.structural_family: disc-like heptanuclear Dy cluster with lattice [Mo(tmphen)O(CN)3]+ countercations

synthesis.procedure: All operations were carried out in a high-purity nitrogen glovebox because K4Mo(CN)7·2H2O is readily oxidized. K4Mo(CN)7·2H2O (0.04 mmol, 18.8 mg) was dissolved in a 1:1 (v/v) acetonitrile/water mixture. DyCl3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, ca. 38 mg) and tmphen (0.2 mmol, 47 mg) were dissolved in 9 mL of the same mixed solvent. The solutions were combined to give a red-brown solution, insoluble material was filtered off, and the filtrate was sealed in a glass bottle and left standing. After one month, red-brown block crystals formed at the bottom together with some brown powder. The crystals were collected by filtration, washed repeatedly with the mother liquor until clean, and dried. During self-assembly the [MoIII(CN)7]4- block was oxidized and decomposed to lattice [Mo(tmphen)O(CN)3]+ cations.

reagents.name: acetonitrile/water
reagents.amount: 1:1 (v/v); 9 mL used to dissolve DyCl3·6H2O and tmphen

synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed glass bottle in a high-purity nitrogen glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtrate left standing for one month; red-brown block crystals collected by filtration, washed repeatedly with mother liquor, and dried.
synthesis.yield: ca. 15 mg, about 27% based on Mo3+

properties.summary: DC susceptibility is consistent with a Dy7 unit and suggests weak antiferromagnetic coupling and/or Stark depopulation, with strong magnetic anisotropy. No clear hysteresis is observed at low temperature because of a quantum-tunneling pathway. Zero-field AC susceptibility shows frequency- and temperature-dependent slow relaxation, identifying compound 1 as a single-molecule magnet with Ueff = 51.6 K (35.8 cm^-1) and τ0 = 17 μs.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 1 kOe DC field; expected spin-only value 99.19 cm^3·mol^-1·K for Dy7

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: low temperature, approximately saturated at 70 kOe

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero-field AC data; Arrhenius fit of relaxation times above 6.0 K; also 35.8 cm^-1

measurements.name: α
measurements.conditions: generalized Debye fits of Cole-Cole plots from 3.0 to 20.0 K under zero field
